sentences.en: You can go by bus, by metro or on foot.
sentences.zh: 你可以坐公交车、地铁或者步行。

sentences.en: Almost stepped on a gecko while going to the metro.
sentences.zh: 去地铁站的路上差点踩到一只壁虎。

sentences.en: In metro cities, the local population mingles freely with visitors.
sentences.zh: 在大城市里，当地居民和游客可以自由互动。
